description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for handling input validation, URL and IP address validation, MAC address validation, SSID name validation, and includes a CSRF protection library initialization. It is part of the 'actionHandler' folder and provides common validation utilities used across the project.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only printable ASCII characters within a specified range or all if no range is specified.

methods.name: noSpace
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains at least one non-whitespace character.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates whether the provided IP address is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates whether the provided string is a valid URL component per the URL specification.

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Validates whether the provided MAC address is correctly formatted and not a multicast address.

methods.name: validPort
methods.description: Checks if the port number is within the valid range 1-65535.

methods.name: validId
methods.description: Checks if the ID is within the range 1-256.

methods.name: validId_PC
methods.description: Validates parental control IDs, allowing ranges like '10' or '10_12'.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within a given array.

methods.name: isValInRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within a specified numeric range.

methods.name: validURL
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a properly formatted URL, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Checks if a start time is less than an end time and both are within 00:00-23:59.

methods.name: validDays
methods.description: Validates if the input string contains only days of the week abbreviations.

methods.name: valid_ssid_name
methods.description: Validates SSID names based on length, reserved prefixes, and forbidden substrings.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Checks if the string does not contain invalid characters like <, >, &, ', ", |.
